title: NegativeUNL
key_points: UNL (Uniform Name Lookup) is a feature in the XRP Ledger that allows clients to look up information about accounts, addresses, and other objects.
The NegativeUNL flag specifies that a client should not be able to look up information using UNL for certain accounts or address ranges.
When set on an account or address range, NegativeUNL prevents UNL queries from returning any information related to the protected entities.
This feature is useful for protecting sensitive data and ensuring privacy in the XRP Ledger ecosystem.
limitations: The scope of this document is limited to the description of the NegativeUNL feature within the XRP Ledger protocol.
This document does not cover implementation details or practical use cases for developers using the XRP Ledger.
